daily_thesis: The July 28 batch is less about larger robot-policy backbones than about the evidence surfaces that make an action, map, or navigation decision trustworthy. DeVA, N0-VTLA, N0-TWAM, and FutureRTC all expose physical state before action execution: depth and affordance cues, latent tactile tokens, future touch, and execution-time observations. ArmnetBench and Data Pyramid turn embodied progress into data provenance plus repeatable real-world rollout infrastructure. The SLAM, off-road navigation, visual localization, driving, and risk-guided flight papers make the same point from another angle: intermediate state estimates need association confidence, freshness, and risk horizon. APRL should therefore treat physical-state logging and resettable evaluation cells as first-class research assets.

clusters.cluster: Robot action models expose physical state before trusting the next chunk
clusters.why: DeVA injects physical guidance into action prediction, N0-VTLA predicts latent tactile tokens, N0-TWAM makes touch a native world-action stream, and FutureRTC corrects stale observations before execution. Together they argue that the action tensor is not the right unit of comparison unless the rollout also records the physical state that made the action valid.
clusters.confidence_note: Multiple robot-policy papers share the same action-to-physical-state interface move.
clusters.lab_action: Run one tabletop task with four logs per action chunk: raw action, predicted depth or affordance, predicted tactile state, and execution-time observation age. Score failure prediction before score-based policy comparison.

paper_autopsies.title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Video-action models often ask one backbone to learn visual dynamics and action prediction at once, so policy failure is hard to assign to future-frame modeling, geometric grounding, or the action head.
paper_autopsies.friction: Robot actions need spatial contact evidence. A visually plausible future does not tell the action decoder where the robot can safely touch, push, or grasp.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: The policy should expose physical guidance as an intermediate interface, not bury it inside a fused latent sequence.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: DeVA decouples video dynamics from action prediction and injects depth/affordance-style physical tokens into the action stream.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: Layer-wise video features feed an action transformer through cross-attention, while a physical guidance module aggregates multi-level video features into affordance and depth maps that condition action chunks.

decisive_evidence.claim: The model explicitly separates video dynamics modeling from action prediction.
The physical guidance module converts depth and affordance estimates into tokens for the action head.
The method is organized around a decoupled video-action architecture with multi-level feature interaction.
Evaluation spans RoboCasa, LIBERO, LIBERO-plus, and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If physical guidance helps only on visually easy manipulation tasks, the module may be a regularizer rather than a real action-validity interface.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Depth and affordance maps can be confidently wrong under occlusion, transparent objects, or deformable contact. The paper's interface still needs failure labels.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Split a robot policy into visual prediction, physical guidance, and action emission; then test which interface actually predicts rollout failure.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: The interface transfers best to tasks where depth and affordance are visible before contact. It needs tactile or force evidence for hidden-contact regimes.

paper_autopsies.title: N0-VTLA: Scaling Vision-Tactile-Language-Action Model with Latent Tactile Tokens
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: Tactile observations are often appended as another context stream, which lets sparse touch be ignored by a model optimized for dense vision and language tokens.
paper_autopsies.friction: Contact-rich manipulation is decided by future fingertip change, not just the current tactile frame.
paper_autopsies.hidden_premise: Touch should become a predicted action-conditioning variable, so the policy is forced to use it at the point of action generation.
paper_autopsies.conceptual_move: N0-VTLA predicts latent tactile tokens for the coming action chunk and conditions the action expert on those tokens.
paper_autopsies.mechanism: A tactile encoder builds tactile-difference tokens, a predictor estimates future tactile tokens from the vision-language prefix, and the action expert is trained to depend on them.

decisive_evidence.claim: The model encodes vision, instruction, and tactile difference images, then conditions a flow-matching action expert on latent tactile tokens.
Future tactile targets are generated by applying the tactile encoder to a future tactile difference.
The vision-language context is masked during action-expert alignment so action prediction must draw on latent tactile tokens.
Latent tactile tokens are the core interface rather than a late auxiliary feature.

paper_autopsies.falsification_frontier: If masking the vision-language context does not improve contact tasks or robustness, the latent tactile interface may not carry decisive control information.
paper_autopsies.adversarial_read: Future tactile prediction can overfit sensor geometry and platform-specific contact. Cross-embodiment claims need canonical action and state checks.
paper_autopsies.transferable_thinking_tool: Make the hidden contact variable a prediction target, then require the action head to consume it before comparing policy families.
paper_autopsies.transfer_boundary: This transfers to tactile-equipped grippers and contact-rich manipulation; it does not help camera-only platforms unless another hidden-state sensor is available.

paper_autopsies.title: N0-TWAM: Scaling Tactile-Native World Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
paper_autopsies.status_quo_belief: VLA and video world-model stacks inherit visual priors, but fingertip events can decide task success while staying invisible to cameras.
paper_autopsies.friction: A model must predict touch and act from touch without tripling the cost of a full-width expert for every modality.

tier_c.title: Observer-Assisted Relative-Velocity Compensation with LPV-$H_\infty$ Robust Correction for 3D Trajectory Tracking of Underactuated Non-Minimum-Phase AUVs under Ocean Currents
tier_c.problem: This paper develops an observer-assisted control architecture for 3D trajectory tracking of torpedo-type underactuated AUVs with non-minimum-phase sway/heave dynamics under unknown ocean currents.
tier_c.method: A three-stage state-current observer provides relative-velocity estimates to a nonlinear feedforward term for dominant current rejection and to an LMI-certified LPV-$\mathcal{H}_\infty$ correction layer.
